sources.title: GitHub - R00taccess/portable-ai-drive: Portable local AI (chat, image ...
sources.snippet: Portable local AI (chat, image, voice) on a USB drive. Unlike a bare portable llama.cpp folder, it detects your GPU/RAM, picks models + quant sizes that fit, downloads the right engine build (CUDA/Vulkan/CPU) with SHA-256 checks, auto-tunes context, adds image + voice, and builds 1-click launchers.
